title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Rashee Rice has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Rice was unable to practice all week. It will be Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen leading the Chiefs wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (groin) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: McDuffie felt a pull in his groin on Thursday. He will be a game-time decision.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Huntley to start again for Ravens Sunday
items.desc: Tyler Huntley will start again for the Ravens on Sunday against the Browns.
items.impact: Lamar Jackson was ruled out after not practicing all week. Huntley holds some intrigue as a QB2 play in 2-QB and superflex leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Abdul Carter (calf) practices Friday
items.desc: Abdul Carter returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Carter had missed the first two days of practice. Giants coach John Harbaugh said he thought Carter was a full participant in practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matt Hibner (hand) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Matt Hibner has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Hibner was unable to practice all week. He is not considered a candidate for injured reserve as of now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Jurgens (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Cam Jurgens has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Jurgens remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: Derek Barnett is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Schwesinger (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Carson Schwesinger is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Schwesinger was seen in a walking boot to start the week. Still, he'll have a chance to take the field on Sunday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Judkins was able to return to practice on Friday after missing the first two days of practice. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out for Week 6
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 6 by the Arizona Cardinals according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Love will not suit up after struggling to reach the practice field throughout the week, putting Tyler Allgeier in line for a sizeable workload as the No. 1 option in the Arizona backfield against the Rams Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Mason Graham is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Graham did not play last week. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Za'Darius Smith (neck) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Smith will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Henderson (groin) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: C.J. Henderson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Henderson missed practice all week. The Falcons secondary will be short-handed without him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Sampson returned to practice for the first time on Thursday. He'll have a chance to return next week against the Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) ruled out for Week 6
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 6 for the Baltimore Ravens according to Brian Wacker.
items.impact: Jackson will be sidelined for the second consecutive game with the ankle injury for head coach Jesse Minter after being unable to practice to this point, with backup Tyler Huntley to start behind center against the Cleveland Browns Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) not seen at practice Friday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III was not seen at practice again on Friday.
items.impact: Davis is trending towards being ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Campbell (knee) practicing Friday
items.desc: Will Campbell was practicing again on Friday.
items.impact: Campbell was listed as a limited participant on Thursday. He will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) practices Friday
items.desc: A.J. Brown was at practice again on Friday.
items.impact: Brown continues to trend towards making his return for Sunday's game against the Jets. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) practicing Friday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson was at practice again on Friday.
items.impact: Henderson was limited in practice again on Thursday. It was seeming like he would be sidelined this week after suffering a high-ankle sprain, but he has practiced all week. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) off injury report, will play Sunday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) is off of the Falcons injury report and will play on Sunday against the Bears.
items.impact: Penix was on the injury report most of the week with a ribs injury but looks good to go against the Bears. He doesn't have a super high ceiling, and he's hovered around low-end QB2 territory since returning from injury, but against the Bears soft defense, he could put up a usable performance this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold not considering being benched per HC Mike Macdonald
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said he is not considering benching Sam Darnold.
items.impact: This comes one day after Darnold threw two more interceptions in a close loss where the Seahawks defense dominated. He is now up to seven interceptions on the season despite missing essentially the first two weeks where Lock played well and took care of the ball. It appears Darnold will remain the quarterback in Week 7 against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Trevor Etienne is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Etienne practiced in full all week. He'll have a good chance to be activated closer to Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: AJ Dillon has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Dillon did not practice all week. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kevin Winston Jr. (undisclosed) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Kevin Winston Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.impact: Winston did not practice all week. He'll be sidelined on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) seen at practice Friday
items.desc: Stefon Diggs was seen practicing on Friday.
items.impact: It is a positive sign for Diggs after he missed practice on Thursday to open the week. He'll have one more day to practice on Saturday ahead of Monday's game against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) uncertain for Week 7
items.desc: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said it's "too early to tell" if Baker Mayfield will be able to play in Week 7 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Mayfield remains week-to-week as he has yet to resume throwing. Jalon Daniels will continue to start this week.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Joe Milton III signs with Eagles
items.desc: Joe Milton III signed with the Eagles on Friday.
items.impact: Milton has been on the Cowboys' practice squad all season to this point. The sixth-round draft pick from 2024 appeared in four games for the Cowboys last season, completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions. Milton brings some dual-threat potential, as he also rushed for 50 yards on five carries last season. With Jalen Hurts' health status completely up in the air due to a blood clot in his calf, the Eagles now have a QB trio consisting of Milton along with Sunday's presumed starter Tanner McKee and rookie Cole Payton.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) to return in Week 6
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will return for the Jets on Sunday against the Patriots.
items.impact: Cooper has not played since he was knocked out of the Jets' season opener with a sprained ankle. The first-round rookie has returned to limited practice sessions this week, and it was announced Friday morning that he's ready for in-game action. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) remaining out this week, Cooper should slot right in behind Garrett Wilson at wide receiver for the Jets. However, there is certainly a chance that Cooper is eased back into the mix as far as total snaps go.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out for Week 6
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) will not play in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Hall will miss a third straight game due to a quad injury. Braelon Allen will shoulder the load out of the Jets' backfield once again in Week 6.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) out for Week 6
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Mitchell will miss his fourth consecutive game this week. Rookie first-rounder Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle), veteran Tim Patrick, and Isaiah Williams should slot in behind Garrett Wilson in the WR pecking order for the Jets on Sunday.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) looks good to go for Week 6
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) practices in full Friday.
items.impact: Sadiq looks to be finishing up his time in the league's concussion protocol on Friday. The rookie tight end is expected to play Sunday against the Patriots.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Darius Slayton released by Colts
items.desc: Darius Slayton was released by the Colts on Friday.
items.impact: After being released by the Giants just before the season began, Slayton signed with the Colts in late September. The veteran receiver never got into a game for the Colts and has now been cut loose again. Slayton will now try to find another new team.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Eric Murray (concussion) trending toward playing Sunday
items.desc: Eric Murray (concussion) is trending toward being active for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Head coach Liam Coen said Friday morning that he feels "more confident" about Murray being able to play in Week 6. Murray missed Week 5's win against the Eagles. If he cannot go Sunday, Rayuan Lane would be in line to start again.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Henry To'oTo'o (shoulder) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Texans opened the practice window of Henry To'oTo'o.
items.impact: To'oTo'o will have 21 days to officially be activated by Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Gesky signs with Giants
items.desc: The Giants signed OL Josh Gesky to the practice squad.
items.impact: Gesky will add depth on the offensive line for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shawn Bowman promoted to 53-man roster
items.desc: The Cardinals promoted TE Shawn Bowman to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Bowman will add depth in the tight end room for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Irvin Charles moved to Seahawks practice squad
items.desc: The Seahawks moved WR Irvin Charles to their practice squad.
items.impact: Charles was activated from injured reserve this week.
